      "link6", np.round(link6,4).tolist(), "axis", np.round(t['axis'],3).tolist())

if not r.ok: handoff("pregrasp move failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code)

r = lib.report("grasp-approach", tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: lib.tgt(link6, M, "precision")},
                                                 slow_approaching=True))
if not r.ok: handoff("grasp approach failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code,
                     err=r.target_error_m)
tip = current().pose(ARM).position

      "err_m", float(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(tip.xyz)-link6)))

      r.measured_opening, r.measured_aperture_mm, r.summary))

import numpy as np
from robot import tools, handoff, target
from ora_lib import current, Direction, Point, Pose
import geom, scene

Q = 0.1501          # jaw contact centre along the approach axis from link6
GRASP_FROM_MOUTH = 0.015
UP = geom.UP

def measure(obs=None):
    obs = obs or current()
    g = scene.world_grid(obs)
    ph = scene.plate_and_holes(g)
    tb = scene.tubes(g, obs)
    return obs, g, ph, tb

def tube_by_index(tb, i):
    return tb[i]

def grasp_geometry(t):
    a = geom.horiz(t['axis'])
    pg = t['mouth'] - GRASP_FROM_MOUTH*a
    X = np.array([0.0,0.0,-1.0]); Y = np.cross(a, UP)
    M = geom.rot_from_xy(X, Y)
    link6 = pg + Q*UP
    return a, pg, M, link6

def tgt(p, M, interaction=None):
    return target(Point(np.asarray(p,float), 'world'),
                  approach=Direction(M[:,0], 'world'),
                  jaw_line=Direction(M[:,1], 'world'),
                  interaction=interaction)

def report(tag, r):
    print("%s: ok=%s status=%s fail=%s err=%s cut=%s" % (tag, r.ok, r.status, r.failure_code,
          r.target_error_m, r.cut_short))
    if not r.ok or r.status not in ('reached','executed','completed'):
        print("   summary:", r.summary)
    return r

def tube_measure_near(tb, p, tol=0.12):
    best=None; bd=1e9
    for t in tb:
        d=float(np.linalg.norm(t['center']-np.asarray(p,float)))
        if d<bd: bd=d; best=t
    return best, bd

import numpy as np
from robot import tools
from ora_lib import current
from scipy.optimize import least_squares

def cam_points(obs, name):
    cam=obs.camera(name)
    rgb=np.asarray(cam.rgb).astype(int); depth=np.asarray(cam.depth_m,float)
    K=np.asarray(cam.K); T=np.asarray(cam.camera_to_world); rot=T[:3,:3]; o=T[:3,3]
    H,W=depth.shape
    uu,vv=np.meshgrid(np.arange(W),np.arange(H))
    Xc=(uu-K[0,2])*depth/K[0,0]; Yc=(vv-K[1,2])*depth/K[1,1]
    xyz=(np.stack([Xc,Yc,depth],-1)@rot.T)+o
    return dict(rgb=rgb,depth=depth,K=K,rot=rot,o=o,uu=uu,vv=vv,xyz=xyz,good=np.isfinite(depth)&(depth>0))

def body_points(cp, mask):
    rgb=cp['rgb']; good=cp['good']
    Cr,Cg,Cb=rgb[...,0],rgb[...,1],rgb[...,2]
    orange=(Cr>190)&(Cr-Cb>45)&(Cg>140)&good
    body=mask&(~orange)&good
    return cp['xyz'][body], body

def fit_cyl(P):
    c=P.mean(0); Q=P-c
    w,V=np.linalg.eigh(Q.T@Q/len(Q)); d=V[:,-1]
    def fun(p):
        p0=p[0:3]; dd=p[3:6]; dd=dd/np.linalg.norm(dd); r=p[6]
        v=P-p0; t=v@dd; perp=v-np.outer(t,dd)
        return np.linalg.norm(perp,axis=1)-r
    r0=float(np.median(np.linalg.norm(Q-np.outer(Q@d,d),axis=1)))
    res=least_squares(fun,[*c,*d,r0],loss='soft_l1',f_scale=0.0015)
    p=res.x; d=p[3:6]/np.linalg.norm(p[3:6])
    v=P-p[0:3]; t=v@d
    return dict(p0=p[0:3],d=d,r=float(p[6]),tmin=float(t.min()),tmax=float(t.max()),
                rms=float(np.sqrt((fun(p)**2).mean())),n=len(P))

def ransac_plane(P, thresh=0.0006, iters=600, seed=0):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
    best=None;bestn=-1
    n=len(P)
    for _ in range(iters):
        i=rng.choice(n,3,replace=False)
        p=P[i]
        nrm=np.cross(p[1]-p[0],p[2]-p[0])
        ln=np.linalg.norm(nrm)
        if ln<1e-9: continue
        nrm/=ln
        d=np.abs((P-p[0])@nrm)
        cnt=int((d<thresh).sum())
        if cnt>bestn: bestn=cnt;best=(nrm,p[0])
    nrm,p0=best
    for _ in range(4):
        d=np.abs((P-p0)@nrm)
        inl=P[d<thresh]
        if len(inl)<10: break
        c=inl.mean(0); Q=inl-c
        w,V=np.linalg.eigh(Q.T@Q/len(Q)); nrm=V[:,0]
        p0=c
    d=np.abs((P-p0)@nrm); inl=P[d<thresh]
    c=inl.mean(0); Q=inl-c
    w,V=np.linalg.eigh(Q.T@Q/len(Q)); nrm=V[:,0]
    if nrm[2]<0: nrm=-nrm
    rad=float(np.sqrt(max(w[1]+w[2],0)))
    return dict(n=nrm,c=c,r=rad,count=len(inl),rms=float(np.sqrt((Q@nrm).var())),total=n)

import numpy as np
import robot
from robot import tools, handoff
from ora_lib import current
import geom, lib, policy

ARM='left'; Q=lib.Q
obs=current(); pose=obs.pose(ARM); p0=np.asarray(pose.xyz,float); R0=np.asarray(pose.matrix,float)[:3,:3]
grip=p0+Q*R0[:,0]
ha=policy.held_axis('left_wrist',grip)
print("held:",None if ha is None else {k:(np.round(v,4).tolist() if isinstance(v,np.ndarray) else (round(v,5) if isinstance(v,float) else v)) for k,v in ha.items()})
res=policy.reorient_min(ARM,label="tubeM")
print("reorient done:", np.round(res['R'][:,0],4).tolist())

def rot_axis(k, ang):
    k=np.asarray(k,float); k=k/np.linalg.norm(k)
    K=np.array([[0,-k[2],k[1]],[k[2],0,-k[0]],[-k[1],k[0],0]])
    return np.eye(3)+np.sin(ang)*K+(1-np.cos(ang))*(K@K)

def held_axis(cam='left_wrist', grip=None, radius=0.13, tag=""):
    """axis direction (mouth->) of the held tube from a cylinder fit + orange centroid."""
    obs=current()
    cp=cylfit.cam_points(obs,cam)
    xyz=cp['xyz']; rgb=cp['rgb']; good=cp['good']
    Cr,Cg,Cb=rgb[...,0],rgb[...,1],rgb[...,2]
    near=good&(np.linalg.norm(xyz-grip,axis=-1)<radius)
    white=(Cr>175)&(Cg>175)&(Cb>175)&near
    orange=(Cr>185)&(Cr-Cb>45)&(Cg>135)&near
    if white.sum()<200: return None
    f=cylfit.fit_cyl(xyz[white])
    if f['rms']>0.004 or not (0.008<f['r']<0.020): return None
    d=f['d'].copy()
    if orange.sum()>30:
        po=xyz[orange].mean(0)
        if (po-f['p0'])@d<0: d=-d
    P=xyz[white|orange]
    t=(P-f['p0'])@d
    hist,edges=np.histogram(t,bins=40); keep=hist>0.25*hist.max()
    idx=np.nonzero(keep)[0]
    tlo,thi=float(edges[idx[0]]),float(edges[idx[-1]+1])
    pa=f['p0']+0.5*(tlo+thi)*d
    p_mouth=f['p0']+thi*d
    p_bot=f['p0']+tlo*d
    return dict(axis=d, p_axis=pa, r=f['r'], rms=f['rms'], n=f['n'], span=thi-tlo,
                p_hi=p_mouth, p_lo=p_bot, orange_n=int(orange.sum()))

def reorient_min(arm, cam='left_wrist', label="tube"):
    obs=current(); pose=obs.pose(arm); p0=np.asarray(pose.xyz,float); R0=np.asarray(pose.matrix,float)[:3,:3]
    grip=p0+Q*R0[:,0]
    ha=held_axis(cam, grip, tag=label)
    if ha is None: handoff("held tube axis not measurable", cam=cam)
    a_w=ha['axis']
    tilt=np.degrees(np.arccos(min(1,abs(a_w[2]))))
    print("[%s] held axis=%s r=%.4f rms=%.5f span=%.4f tilt_from_vertical=%.1f"%(label,
          np.round(a_w,4).tolist(),ha['r'],ha['rms'],ha['span'],tilt))
    a_local=R0.T@a_w
    k=np.cross(a_w,UP); s=np.linalg.norm(k)
    if s<1e-5: R1=R0.copy()
    else:
        ang=np.arccos(max(-1,min(1,float(a_w@UP))))
        R1=rot_axis(k,ang)@R0
    print("   residual R1@a_local - UP = %s"%(np.round(R1@a_local-UP,4).tolist()))
    h=R1[:,0]
    link6=grip-Q*h
    print("   h=%s link6=%s"%(np.round(h,4).tolist(),np.round(link6,4).tolist()))
    r=lib.report("reorient", tools.move_pose(targets={arm: lib.tgt(link6,R1,"precision")}, speed="normal",
                                             exact_orientation=True))
    if not r.ok: handoff("reorient failed",status=r.status,failure=r.failure_code)
    obs=current(); pose=obs.pose(arm); p0=np.asarray(pose.xyz,float); R=np.asarray(pose.matrix,float)[:3,:3]
    grip=p0+Q*R[:,0]
    ha2=held_axis(cam, grip, tag=label)
    if ha2 is not None:
        print("[%s] after reorient axis=%s tilt=%.2f"%(label,np.round(ha2['axis'],4).tolist(),
              np.degrees(np.arccos(min(1,abs(ha2['axis'][2]))))))
    return dict(R=R, p0=p0, grip=grip, ha=ha2)

def stage_over(arm, hole_xy, clear=0.030, label="tube", cam='left_wrist'):
    hole_xy=np.asarray(hole_xy,float)
    obs=current(); pose=obs.pose(arm); p0=np.asarray(pose.xyz,float); R=np.asarray(pose.matrix,float)[:3,:3]
    grip=p0+Q*R[:,0]
    ha=held_axis(cam, grip, tag=label)
    if ha is None: handoff("tube axis lost at stage", cam=cam)
    a=ha['axis']/np.linalg.norm(ha['axis'])
    if abs(a[2])<0.97: handoff("tube not vertical before stage", axis=a.tolist())
    p_bot=ha['p_axis']- (ha['span']*0.0)  # placeholder
    # bottom = mouth end minus tube length along axis: use lower end
    pbot=ha['p_hi'] if np.dot(ha['p_hi']-ha['p_lo'],UP)<0 else ha['p_lo']
    pbot=pbot - 0*UP
    # recompute bottom via cap/length: use axis extreme along -UP from cap
    cap=cap_measure(cam, near=grip, radius=0.07)
    if cap is not None and abs(cap['n'][2])>0.97:
        pbot=cap['p_cap']-L_TUBE*(cap['n']/np.linalg.norm(cap['n']))
    target_z=0.8255+clear
    delta=np.array([hole_xy[0]-pbot[0], hole_xy[1]-pbot[1], target_z-pbot[2]])

        print("  [%s] %s using nominal geometry"%("".join((label,tag))))
        return grip-(L_TUBE-lib.GRASP_FROM_MOUTH)*UPz, UPz.copy()
